name: Maenam Hillside Villa
description:
Discover relaxed island living in this beautifully designed private villa, offering a perfect combination of modern comfort, tropical surroundings, and everyday practicality.

The villa features spacious open-plan living areas with excellent natural light, creating a seamless connection between the indoor living space and the outdoor pool terrace. Designed for both permanent living and holiday use, the property offers generous bedrooms, stylish bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable entertaining spaces throughout.

Outside, the private infinity swimming pool and terrace provide the ideal setting for relaxing, dining, or entertaining while enjoying Koh Samui's tropical lifestyle.

Located in a desirable area of the island with a magnificent jungle sunset view, the villa offers convenient access to beaches, restaurants, cafés, shops, international schools, and other local amenities while still providing privacy and a peaceful residential atmosphere.

Whether you're looking for a permanent residence, holiday home, or investment property in Koh Samui, this villa offers an attractive opportunity in one of Thailand's most sought-after island destinations.

Property Highlights

Private swimming pool

Spacious open-plan living and dining area

Modern fully equipped kitchen

Generously sized bedrooms

Stylish contemporary bathrooms

Outdoor terrace and entertaining area

Private parking

Quiet and convenient location

Ideal as a residence, holiday home, or rental investment

Excellent access to beaches and local amenities
